Higher Education Committee
Thursday, April 18, 2024
3:00 PM or 15 Minutes After Session, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: Senator Robert J. Kupec

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 5:34pm
S.F. 5326: Senator Fateh: Higher education licensure and grant provisions funding and related policy changes establishment.
Gavel was transferred to Vice Chair Putnam at 5:34pm

The following individuals testified on S.F.5326:
-Ziigwan Frazer, Policy and Advocacy Manager, Foster Advocates

Senator Fateh moved the A4 amendment, MOTION ADOPTED

Senator Fateh moved the AS amendment to the amendment, MOTION ADOPTED
Senator Fateh moved the A6 amendment to the amendment, MOTION ADOPTED
Senator Fateh moved the A11 amendment to the amendment, MOTION ADOPTED
Senator Putnam moved the A8 amendment to the amendment, MOTION ADOPTED

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 5326, as amended, recommended to pass and re-referred to the Finance Committee. - MOTION
ADOPTED.

The meeting was adjourned at 5:55pm

Senator Omar Fateh, Chair Chris Meyer, Legislative Assistant
